text:
Alex: Quick heads up — FinTech prospect wants an on‑prem POC but security insists on a code escrow + KMS demo. They asked if we can waive the 3‑month platform fee in exchange for escrow. Thoughts?
Marie: Are they the same account that asked for a pilot credit earlier? trying to recall.
Ben: Yep same buyer. They pushed back on platform fees last time.
Emma: Technical note: we can demo KMS integration but for private deployments they want customer‑managed keys only. HSM integration is an add‑on.
Raj: From Legal: escrow is fine but needs release triggers (bankruptcy, insolvency, court order). Need escrow agent details and sample clause.
Sarah: Finance: any one‑time escrow/administration fee should be invoiced up front. If it's < $25k we can approve standard one‑time billing; >$25k needs RevOps + FP&A signoff.
Dealbot: Deal desk request created: D-9743. Assigned to @Amanda.
Amanda: Quick read — we don't approve full platform fee waive without revenue protection. Options: (a) 50% platform fee + $X escrow admin fee, (b) full waive if they commit to 12mo follow‑on at a minimum ARR commit. Need SOW + security questionnaire answers to route.
Alex: Customer said they'd consider a 12‑month follow‑on at 50% commit if pilot succeeds. They want the platform waive to reduce immediate cash out.
Emma: I'll attach a short SOW and security answers in 30m. Important: label KMS as "customer‑managed" and call out HSM as separate SKU.
Ben: Can we offer a temporary downgrade/upgrade of support tier for the pilot? They asked for 24/7 for critical incidents during POC.
Raj: Silver support doesn't include 24/7 on‑call. If they need that we either add a paid on‑call addon or document the SLA exception in the SOW. Legal needs precise SLA language.
Amanda: For pricing council: propose one‑time escrow admin fee + 50% platform fee during 3mo pilot, contingent on signed LOI for 12mo follow‑on at agreed commit. I'll escalate to Pricing Council this afternoon.
Sarah: If Pricing Council approves a >30% discount we need VP Sales signoff for revenue recognition and commission impact.
Lydia: (VP Sales) I'll approve the concession conditionally — require signed LOI that includes minimum commit and renewal pricing. Amanda — escalate to Finance + Legal and capture the SOW, security docs, and proposed escrow agent.
Alex: Thanks Lydia — I'll get the LOI draft to Amanda and upload SOW.
Emma: dropping SOW + sec questionnaire links in 30m as promised. Also sample escrow clause for Legal:
```
Escrow clause (draft):
- Trigger: customer bankruptcy, insolvency, or court order
- Agent: proposed IronGate Escrow LLC (sample only)
- Release: upon court order or mutual written consent
- Fees: one‑time admin fee billed to customer
```
Raj: Looks workable; will need agent KYC and indemnity language.
Ben: I'll prep a version of the commercial summary for the customer: pilot terms, escrow fee, commit trigger.
Amanda: Received — routing now. Will update thread with Pricing Council decision and any required signatures. :+1:
Lydia: Good work team. Keep the timeline tight — customer wants POC start within 3 weeks.
Alex: Understood — will push for LOI this week.
